people.name: Esau
people.line: Isaac's firstborn son; sold birthright to Jacob; became Edom.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Rebekah
people.line: Wife of Isaac; mother of Jacob and Esau

translations.web: Rebekah took the good clothes of Esau, her elder son, which were with her in the house, and put them on Jacob, her younger son.
translations.bsb: And Rebekah took the finest clothes in the house that belonged to her older son Esau, and she put them on her younger son Jacob.
translations.kjv: And Rebekah took goodly raiment of her eldest son Esau, which were with her in the house, and put them upon Jacob her younger son:
translations.asv: And Rebekah took the goodly garments of Esau her elder son, which were with her in the house, and put them upon Jacob her younger son.
